login.title: Sign in
login.lead: Pick up where you left off.
login.linkError: That confirmation or reset link is invalid, already used, or expired. Please try again.

signup.title: Sign up
signup.heading: Create an account
signup.lead: Save your practice progress and see how you improve.
signup.sentBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it in this browser to activate your account.
signup.sentSpam: Not in your inbox? Check your spam or promotions folder.
signup.name: Name
signup.agree: I agree to the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> and <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms>

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.lead: Enter your account email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If {email} has an account, we've sent a link to set a new password. Open it in this browser.

reset.title: New password
reset.expiredBody: Open this page from the link in your password reset email. If the link has expired, request a new one.
reset.heading: Set a new password

errors.tooShort: Password is too short. Use at least {min} characters.
errors.mustAgree: You need to agree to the Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions.
errors.resetExpired: This reset link has expired. Request a new one.
errors.emailTaken: This email is already registered. Try signing in, or reset your password if you forgot it.
errors.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Your email isn't confirmed yet. Check your inbox for the confirmation link.
errors.samePassword: Your new password must be different from the old one.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again in a moment.
